decisions_log.chose: fast-forward master to 6dd52cf, then cut phase/9 from master

decisions_log.decision: integer-clustering diagnostic needs a chance baseline
decisions_log.why: the bands are not measure-zero (they cover ~25% of the flagged log-range by chance) and they TOUCH at k=17, above which membership is automatic. The raw 23.5% share is unreadable alone and sits below the flat null; only the per-k local comparison resolves the k=2 excess.

decisions_log.decision: which cross-session flag applies to retracement (T3d)
decisions_log.chose: both components and the union, carried separately
decisions_log.why: the denominator H - A spans the (T-1,T0) boundary because A is a T-1 price and H is a T0 price, so the denominator flag bears on EVERY horizon including t0_close, not only on T+1..T+3.

decisions_log.chose: Gaussian KDE, bandwidth 0.15 log10 units, smoothing used ONLY to locate the trough
decisions_log.why: runway is integer-valued, so log bins below ~10 min are narrower than the integer lattice and alternate populated/empty; the raw argmin returned an EMPTY bin at 1.5 min adjacent to mode 1, not a trough between masses.

options_considered: secondary y-axis as the contract specifies
decisions_log.chose: linked lower panel sharing the x-axis
decisions_log.why: a dual y-scale is the one encoding the project chart standard forbids outright; the panel carries the same information in the same file.

options_considered: split by unit into two panels
decisions_log.why: markout medians near -0.03 log and retracement medians near +1.4 ratio; pooled onto one axis the markout intervals collapse to invisible specks.

surprises: The integer-band share of the flagged set (22.7-24.2% per pair) sits AT OR BELOW the rate expected by chance (24.7-28.4%). The bands are not measure-zero and they touch at k=17. Against a local background the excess is concentrated at k=2 (298 observed vs 210 expected, 1.42x); k=3,4,5 are at or below background.

All 5 of Phase 6b's denom_nonpositive events sit inside the 394 det_undefined, necessarily - H <= A implies H < 1.30*A so detection can never fire. The excursion denominator is undefined for 0 events in the detection universe, not the 5 the prompt anticipated.

runway_minutes is a SINGLE population on the measure-invariant per-minute density, which decays monotonically (342.65/min at 0-20 min to ~10/min by 300 min). The prompt's 'second mass at 120-480 min' is 4,011 events over 360 minutes = 11/min against ~780/min in the first 6 minutes - a counts-per-log-bin effect. The only genuine discontinuity is the atom at exactly 0.

Markouts are exactly 0 whenever no print lands between entry and exit (last-trade-at/before pricing) - a point mass, not a density. That atom DECIDES the median wherever it straddles the 50th percentile, which needs nowhere near a 50% zero share: a cell that is 49.6% negative / 4.6% zero / 45.8% positive reports median exactly 0.0. 34 of 450 T4 cells are in that state.

The (T-1,T0) pair carries the highest flag rate of any session pair at 5.66% (890/15,729) - above the 5% figure used as the row-5 threshold for (T0,T+1). Row 5 names (T0,T+1) explicitly so it is not triggered, but that pair spans the momentum event itself, where a large |r| is the phenomenon under study rather than contamination.
